summary: A database guard closes the ledger of any community whose books trustEd does not keep (books elsewhere, financials off, archived, terminated, past its last day, or a prospect): no journal entry or journal entry line can be inserted, edited, voided or deleted for it, by any path. Existing rows are preserved exactly; reads and exports are unaffected; every active community is unaffected.

preflight.name: the guard does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('trg_journal_entries_books_closed', 'trg_journal_entry_lines_books_closed') AND NOT tgisinternal

preflight.name: only one closed community has ledger rows (Eaglewood)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT je.community_id)::int FROM journal_entries je JOIN communities c ON c.id = je.community_id WHERE c.books_of_record IS DISTINCT FROM 'trusted' OR c.financials_active IS FALSE OR c.management_status IN ('archived', 'terminated', 'prospect') OR (c.management_status = 'terminating' AND c.management_end_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date)

preflight.name: Eaglewood is archived with books in Vantaca
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE name = 'Eaglewood' AND management_status = 'archived' AND books_of_record = 'vantaca' AND financials_active IS FALSE

expected_changes: New function community_books_closed_reason(uuid): NULL when trustEd keeps the books, otherwise the reason.
Triggers on journal_entries and journal_entry_lines refuse INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE for a community whose books are closed (error code P0001, message starting 'books_closed:').
No row changes. Eaglewood's existing journal entries and lines stay exactly as they are.

verify.name: both guard triggers exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('trg_journal_entries_books_closed', 'trg_journal_entry_lines_books_closed') AND NOT tgisinternal

verify.name: Eaglewood's ledger is closed
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE name = 'Eaglewood' AND community_books_closed_reason(id) IS NOT NULL

verify.name: every active community's ledger stays open
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE management_status IN ('active', 'onboarding') AND books_of_record = 'trusted' AND financials_active IS NOT FALSE AND community_books_closed_reason(id) IS NOT NULL

verify.name: Canyon Gate's ledger stays open
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' AND community_books_closed_reason(id) IS NULL

verify.name: Eaglewood still has its 179+ journal entries
verify.sql: SELECT (count(*) >= 179)::int FROM journal_entries je JOIN communities c ON c.id = je.community_id WHERE c.name = 'Eaglewood'
